seo.default_title: Pranav PT — Bringing Technology Closer to Humans
seo.default_description: Understand AI, App Development, Automation & Technology in the simplest way possible.

input_placeholders.query: What would you like to understand?

empty_states.no_results: Nothing here yet — try a different search.

developer_rules: Never hardcode colors inside components — always reference design tokens
Never hardcode spacing values — always use spacing scale
All content must be sourced from /config JSON files
Keep typography fully configurable via design-tokens.json
Components must be reusable and driven by props
Pages must be statically generated where possible (Next.js SSG)

file_structure._note: All files a Next.js developer needs are in /config. Read _dev_guide.json first.

phase_sequence._note: Build in this exact order. Run gate_checks before starting each phase to confirm the previous phase is complete. Detect current phase by running: grep -r "SHELL" components/ — any result means that component is not yet implemented.

phases.name: Scaffold
phases.what: Generate all project files via generate.py
gate_checks: nextjs-app/ folder exists with node_modules/
npm run dev starts without error
localhost:3000 loads — placeholder shells visible
No import errors in browser console

phases.name: UI Primitives
phases.what: Implement Button, Card, Badge, SectionHeader, Divider
gate_checks: None of these 5 files contain the text SHELL
All button variants (primary/secondary/ghost) render correctly
No TypeScript errors for these components

phases.name: Layout + Shared Hero
gate_checks: Navbar renders on every page with all 6 menu items
Mobile menu toggle opens and closes
Footer renders on every page with social links
PageHero shows badge + headline + subheadline on /about

phases.name: Home Page
gate_checks: / shows 4 sections in correct order
HeroFullscreen fills the viewport height
AboutTeaser shows 4 stat cards (110+ videos, 20+ apps, 6000+ community, 4 yrs)
JourneyTeaser shows 4 milestone cards linking to /about#journey
CTABanner buttons navigate correctly

phases.name: About Page
gate_checks: /about shows ProfileBlock with name, designation, stats, expertise areas
/about shows Timeline with all events from Jan 2019 to Today
/about#journey anchor scrolls to the timeline
External links open in new tab with rel=noopener noreferrer
Hobbies section renders nothing — empty array is expected

phases.name: Resources Page
gate_checks: /resources shows grid with category filter tabs (All/Python/AI/Automation/Finance Tech/Tools)
Filter tabs correctly show/hide cards
/resources/python-for-non-coders renders the sample article
Article shows category badge, read time, published date
Back link returns to /resources

phases.name: Learnings Page
gate_checks: /learnings shows course cards
/learnings/automation-python-ai-8-days loads CourseDetail
Syllabus renders as accordion or cards
PLACEHOLDER_PRICE renders as Coming Soon — not broken
Mobile CTA is sticky at bottom of viewport

phases.name: My Builts Page
gate_checks: /my-builts shows 6 tool cards
/my-builts/efficient-document-management loads ToolDetail
Features render as two-column checklist
PLACEHOLDER_PRICE renders as Coming Soon
Back link returns to /my-builts

phases.name: Talk to Me Page
gate_checks: /talk-to-me shows social links (YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Discord)
PLACEHOLDER social links render as href='#' with disabled style
Contact form shows all 4 fields: name, email, subject dropdown, message
Client-side validation fires before POST
Form shows inline success/error — no page redirect

phases.name: Final Review
phases.what: SEO, accessibility, placeholder cleanup, Vercel deploy
gate_checks: grep -r SHELL components/ returns nothing
npm run build succeeds with zero errors
All pages have title and meta description tags
All images have alt text
Focus ring visible on keyboard navigation
No PLACEHOLDER_ values visible in rendered UI
All external links have target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer
Vercel preview deploy succeeds
